title: Replicating Agent Monitor Evaluation on a Different LLM Family (Mistral vs. Llama Baselines)

original_idea.body:
# Replicating Agent Monitor Evaluation on a Different LLM Family (Mistral vs. Llama Baselines)

**Problem:** Most monitoring research uses Anthropic or OpenAI models as the monitored agent. How monitoring performance compares across different open-source model families (Mistral, Llama, Gemma) is understudied.

**Direction:** Run the same set of monitoring evaluation tests (normal tasks + injected attacks) using three open-source model families as the agent. Keep the monitoring classifier constant. Measure per-family detection rates and false positive rates.

**Why it matters:** Model family differences in monitoring susceptibility would imply that monitoring systems must be co-designed with the specific model family being monitored — a major practical implication.

**Relevant context:** METR monitoring evaluation; open-source model diversity; cross-family monitoring.
